The removal of the forward-guidance language stating the fed funds rate would remain 'below levels expected to prevail in the longer run' is explicitly characterized by the Committee itself as 'a reflection of the progress toward achieving the Committee's statutory goals and did not reflect a shift in the approach to policy going forward.'
